title.narrative: Enhancement of Meaningful and Inclusive Youth Participation

description.narrative: The action aims to strengthen the capacity of grassroots CSOs, in particular of the Human Rights Civil Society Network (HRCN), on enhancement of meaningful and inclusive youth participation.The action should contribute to empower young people to have their voices heard, set an agenda and influence policies for increasing meaningful and inclusive youth participation.
